steps.content: Time passes, and food is running out. You're forced to leave the dining room from time to time to search for supplies in other parts of the ship.
At first, Pylgia says she could go alone and asks you to wait in the dining room. You wouldn't hear of it.

Pylgia breaks apart a chair from the wheelhouse and feeds the pieces into the furnace. As the fog rolls back, temperatures have plummeted. You're burning through fuel faster than you get through food. Soon, you've stripped the upper decks of almost everything combustible.
She finishes her work and returns to your side. The two of you wrap yourselves in the only blanket you found in the medical bay, huddling close for warmth.
Wood crackles in the furnace. You clutch her hand tightly.
She tries to soothe you, but you no longer dare to rest. You mustn't fall asleep. As long as she allows, you'll hold on to her hand to make sure she won't suddenly disappear.
Schorl keeps flashing in the depths of your mind, but you don't want to respond.
You're afraid that if you leave, you'll never come back... that you'll never see her again.
